code: download.file(   url = "https://www.annualreviews.org/docserver/fulltext/genom/25/1/annurev-genom-021623-081639.pdf?expires=1731900753&id=id&accname=guest&checksum=AC39C6258EF7E19E7426CB44F2B37958",   destfile = "Taylor_etal.pdf"   ) list.files(pattern = "pdf") #> [1]"Taylor_etal.pdf"

title: Getting Started
text: Let’s get basic information: title, year, journal name. file separate row. ➡ function supports caching, hopefully saves time query costs! can delete relocate cached file rerun scratch. ⚠️ recommend checking data regularly anything doesn’t make sense.
